questions.q: What URL does the unified Microsoft Purview portal live at?
options: portal.azure.com
purview.microsoft.com
admin.microsoft.com
compliance.microsoft.com
questions.explain: Every Purview capability is reached through the single unified web app at https://purview.microsoft.com, which replaced the old split compliance and governance portals.

questions.q: What determines which solution cards you see on the Purview portal home page?
options: Your permissions and your organization's licensing
Alphabetical order, the same for every user
A random selection shown daily
Only the Global Administrator sees any cards
questions.explain: Solution cards are shown based on what you have permissions and a supported subscription for — two users in the same tenant can see different cards.

questions.q: What stays the same in the left navigation no matter which Purview solution you're inside?
options: Nothing — every solution has a completely unique navigation with no shared items
The shared shell: Home, Solutions, Learn, and Settings
Only the Settings gear, everything else changes
The solution's name always appears at the very bottom
questions.explain: The portal shares one skeleton — Home, Solutions, Learn, and Settings stay fixed at the top of the left navigation, while the items below them change depending on which solution you've selected.

questions.q: Which of the Solutions page's four sections does Data Catalog belong to?
options: Core
Risk & Compliance
Data Governance
Data Security
questions.explain: Data Catalog sits in the Data Governance section of the Solutions page — the same pillar this course focuses on, alongside Data Lifecycle Management.

questions.q: According to this lesson, why do Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Entra appear under 'Related portals' instead of becoming Purview solution cards?
options: Because they are being discontinued
Because Purview doesn't try to absorb every Microsoft product — some stay their own products with their own portals, linked from Purview for convenience
Because they require a separate, unrelated login system with no connection to Purview
Because they are only available in preview and not yet supported
questions.explain: The 'Related portals' section is a reminder that Purview consolidates security, governance, and compliance solutions, but products like Fabric and Entra remain their own products, just linked from the Purview portal for convenience.
